UI_RMMP_StatusPickFirst: Click on the map to select the FIRST corner of the region.
UI_RMMP_StatusPickSecond: Click on the map to select the SECOND corner of the region.
UI_RMMP_StatusReady: Both corners selected. Fill in the form and click Submit.
UI_RMMP_StatusSecondUpdated: Second corner updated. Fill in the form and click Submit.
UI_RMMP_NoteSingleRoll: Single-roll system: one random roll (0-99) is reused for all properties.
UI_RMMP_NoteConflicts: Conflicting chances are not weighted together. Example:
UI_RMMP_NoteMaxHitsOnlyTough: maxHits applies only when zombie rolls as Tough.
UI_RMMP_NoteMaxHitsDesc: It is the number of hits absorbed before taking damage.
UI_RMMP_SaySelectBoth: Finish drawing a region, or set both corners first.
UI_RMMP_MapHint: Drag to pan. Scroll to zoom. Right-click to set corners.
UI_RMMP_DrawHint: Drag a rectangle on the map. Right-click to cancel.
UI_RMMP_TraitFieldHint: 0-100%. Blank keeps the default. 0 explicitly disables this chance.
UI_RMMP_TraitRules: Cognition controls door opening. Sight and hearing each use a separate deterministic roll per zombie. Chances are thresholds, not weights: best, normal, poor, then random. Unmatched rolls use sandbox defaults. Good/Pinpoint Hearing and Bad/Poor senses are aliases; the higher chance wins. Overlapping regions use the highest chance per property. Blank fields inherit category properties, then sandbox defaults.
UI_RMMP_InvalidChance: Enter a percentage between 0 and 100, or leave the field blank.
UI_RMMP_SelectionReady: Region selected. Complete the form and save.
UI_RMMP_EntryMessageHint: Shown when a player enters this region. Leave blank for no message.
UI_RMMP_ForcedPVPHint: Overrides sandbox PvP safety settings only where PvP is enabled. Missing/true forces safety off; false leaves safety optional. New regions default to false. Existing missing values stay unchanged.
UI_RMMP_PopulationTargetHint: Positive count enables population control. Blank inherits category settings; 0 disables additions. The density ceiling also limits this target.
UI_RMMP_PopulationDensityHint: Region-wide density ceiling on this floor. Effective target is the lower of the count and floor(area x density / 100). Blank inherits; default 1. Zero disables additions.
UI_RMMP_PopulationBudgetHint: Total successful additions for this region ID, preserved across unloads and restarts. Blank defaults to the effective target. Raising this value permits more additions when replenishment is enabled.
UI_RMMP_PopulationIntervalHint: Minimum real seconds between single-zombie additions. Blank inherits; default 30.
UI_RMMP_PopulationRespawnHint: Uses zombieRespawn for this module only. Enabled permits top-ups within the lifetime allowance; disabled stops permanently once the target is met. Does not override vanilla zombie respawn.
UI_RMMP_InvalidPopulation: Enter valid population values within the displayed ranges. Count and allowance must be whole numbers. Blank fields inherit defaults.
